verdict.rationale: Skyfire publishes both a human-browsable Directory of payable services (skyfire-docs-13) and a programmatic discovery path via its MCP server's 'find-sellers' tool, explicitly described as enabling agents to 'Discover sellers' and orchestrate commerce workflows (skyfire-docs-15, skyfire-supp-9, skyfire-docs-6). This directly satisfies agent-driven discovery of payable services/APIs through a published index or directory. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that find-sellers returns a real service catalog, and a public OpenAPI/discovery spec (the openapi.json probe returned 404s).
